description: This file implements the Web::JSONWebToken class and related data structures for handling JSON Web Tokens, including encoding, decoding, signature validation, and payload extraction. It also defines the JSONWebData class for JSON serialization of token data.

classes.name: JSONWebData
classes.description: A JSON container class representing the token's header data, including type and algorithm.

methods.name: JSONWebToken::Encode
methods.description: Encodes a payload into a JWT token string, including header, payload, and signature.

methods.name: JSONWebToken::Decode
methods.description: Decodes a JWT token string into payload data after verifying the signature.

methods.name: JSONWebToken::ValidSignature
methods.description: Validates the signature of a JWT token based on the specified mode.

methods.name: JSONWebToken::PayloadLength
methods.description: Calculates the payload length from the token.
